strat_breakout_confirm_v3.hypothesis_statement: HYPOTHESIS V3: Stocks emerging from a 20-day tight consolidation squeeze (width <= 15%) that achieve a 2-session Donchian 20-day high Close confirmation with RVOL >= 1.2 filter false breakout noise, improving trend continuation quality and reducing execution cost erosion.
strat_breakout_confirm_v3.economic_rationale: Tight 15% Donchian consolidation squeezes filter false breakouts and 2-session Close confirmation ensures institutional trend commitment.
strat_breakout_confirm_v3.behavioural_rationale: Reduces false-breakout whipsaws in choppy market regimes.
strat_breakout_confirm_v3.diagnosed_v2_failure: Breakout V2 suffered 49.1% cost erosion and PF 1.09 < 1.30 due to single-bar false breakouts.
strat_breakout_confirm_v3.post_hoc_evidence_used: Diagnostic finding of high false breakout noise in wide consolidation channels.

parameter_origins.justification: Classic 20-day Donchian channel period preserved from V2.
Tightened from 20% to 15% based on diagnostic observation of false breakouts in wide channels; alternative values were not tested.
2-session Close confirmation above Donchian high ensures sustained institutional buying before entry.
RVOL >= 1.2 preserved from V2 canonical definition.
Increased to 2.0 ATR to accommodate normal breakout re-test noise without early stop-out.

strat_breakout_confirm_v3.expected_effect: Higher win rate, lower transaction cost ratio, and Profit Factor >= 1.30.
strat_breakout_confirm_v3.falsification_condition: Profit Factor < 1.30 or Expectancy R < +0.25R on DEVELOPMENT.

strat_mean_reversion_v3.hypothesis_statement: HYPOTHESIS V3: Stocks in structural uptrends (Close > SMA200) experiencing an oversold dip (RSI(5) <= 35.0) with displacement >= 1.0 ATR that exhibit a 1-day bullish reversal trigger (Close > Prev Close) eliminate falling-knife entries, improving win rate and elevating Expectancy R above +0.25R.
strat_mean_reversion_v3.economic_rationale: A 1-session bullish reversal candle (Close > Prev Close) after an RSI(5) <= 35.0 dip in long-term uptrends prevents entering unconfirmed falling legs.
strat_mean_reversion_v3.behavioural_rationale: Eliminates 'falling knife' entries during sharp liquidation phases.
strat_mean_reversion_v3.diagnosed_v2_failure: Mean Reversion V2 achieved 10.8% win rate and +0.18R expectancy (failing +0.25R gate) due to unconfirmed entries.
strat_mean_reversion_v3.post_hoc_evidence_used: Diagnostic finding that premature entries into falling legs drove low win rate.

parameter_origins.justification: Tightened from 40.0 to 35.0 to select deeper short-term pullbacks; alternative values were not tested.
1.0 ATR displacement preserved from V2 canonical definition.
1-session bullish candle reversal trigger ensures price has stopped falling before entry.
Extended from 5 to 7 sessions to allow mean reversion to complete to SMA20 baseline.
1.5 ATR stop loss placement preserved from V2 canonical definition.

strat_mean_reversion_v3.expected_effect: Win rate improvement toward 35% gate and Expectancy R >= +0.25R.
strat_mean_reversion_v3.falsification_condition: Expectancy R < +0.25R or Profit Factor < 1.30 on DEVELOPMENT.
